notes:
*** DUPLICATE: ROW 1519 IS THE SAME PERSON AS ROW 1260 (Dr. Naresh Kumar K L). DE-DUPLICATE BEFORE ANY OUTREACH - DO NOT CONTACT TWICE AND DO NOT COUNT AS TWO PROSPECTS. *** This row was investigated as a possible third person and it is not one. Reasoning set out in full below, as instructed.

THE DECISIVE EVIDENCE IS AIG'S OWN SLUG. The only AIG per-doctor URL that exists anywhere in the index for a cardiothoracic 'Naresh Kumar' is https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-naresh-kumar/ - the BARE name, with no initials. That is precisely the name form the workbook used for row 1519. Row 1260 recorded that exact same URL for Dr. Naresh Kumar K L. So AIG publishes this surgeon WITHOUT his 'K L' initials, and the workbook has ingested him twice: once as AIG renders him ('Dr. Naresh Kumar', row 1519) and once with his initials attached ('Dr. Naresh Kumar K L', row 1260). One slug, one page, one man. Both rows also carry the identical hospital (AIG) and the identical specialty (cardiothoracic surgery), and no experience figure was supplied for either, so there is nothing in the source data that distinguishes them.

THERE IS NO THIRD PERSON. Six queries, three of them restricted to aighospitals.com, surfaced exactly ONE cardiothoracic surgeon named Naresh Kumar attached to AIG. AIG's own cardiothoracic pages ( https://aighospitals.com/speciality/cardiothoracic-surgery and https://aighospitals.com/doctors?speciality=33 ) return Dr. C Sukesh Kumar Reddy and Dr. Arvind Reddy as the department's named surgeons plus the dead dr-naresh-kumar page - no second, differently-initialled Naresh Kumar appears in any AIG URL family (/doctor/, /doctors/, /doctor-profile/<slug>, /doctor-profile/<numeric-id>), on any listing, or on any translate.goog mirror. Confirming the single identity from the other direction, an open-web query on 'Naresh Kumar' + AIG + cardiothoracic + Leipzig returned this exact biography: 'Dr Naresh Kumar is a well experienced Cardiothoracic Surgeon practising at AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad. He received training in Cardio Thoracic Surgery at Leipzig Heart Centre in Germany and has been working as a Consultant Cardio Thoracic Surgeon at AIG Hospital - Gachibowli since July 2018... He completed his MCh in Cardio Thoracic Surgery at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in 2015.' That is row 1260's fingerprint exactly - Leipzig, AIG Gachibowli, July 2018, MCh NIMS 2015 - and it is published on drnareshkumar.co.in, which is K L's site. The bare-name AIG rendering and the K L rendering therefore resolve to a single biography.

Dr Naresh Kumar P V IS DEFINITIVELY EXCLUDED - HE IS NOT THIS ROW. He is a genuinely different and much more senior cardiothoracic and vascular surgeon at APOLLO Hospitals, not AIG: 25+ years of experience, MCh from AIIMS, Senior Consultant and Professor in CTVS, his own separate site pvnaresh.com, and pages at apollohospitals.com and apollo247.com. He is dangerous because he shares the core name, the city, the specialty AND also trained at Leipzig - so the discriminator used here was the HOSPITAL, which is the assigned fact: row 1519 says AIG, and P V Naresh Kumar is Apollo. NOTHING from any Apollo, apollo247, credihealth-Chennai or pvnaresh.com page has been recorded in this row. A CAUTION FOR WHOEVER USES THIS DATA: one WebSearch summary during this session blended the two men, asserting an AIG surgeon with '25 years' and an 'MCh from AIIMS'. That blend is a search-summary artifact, it is wrong, and it was discarded rather than recorded - exactly the failure mode section 4 warns about. Also excluded: the aesthetic dermatologist at drnareshkumar.IN (near-identical domain, different person - only the .CO.IN domain, whose own copy names AIG and cardiothoracic surgery, is recorded), Dr. Naresh Kumar Aggarwal (cardiac anaesthetist, Manipal Delhi), and the Ghaziabad and Shree Aggarsain general-medicine doctors of the same name.

WHY NOT 'Ambiguous Match': that status is for two people who cannot be told apart. Here the opposite is true - the two candidates (K L at AIG, P V at Apollo) are cleanly separable on hospital, seniority, degree and personal domain, and row 1519 lands unambiguously on the AIG one. Recording it as ambiguous would discard good information.

CONTACTS ARE INTENTIONALLY MIRRORED FROM ROW 1260, WITH THE REASON STATED. Because this is the same man, the same routes are the correct answer, and blanking them would make row 1519 look like an unresearched dead row. They are therefore repeated here AND explicitly flagged as shared, not additional. Any deduplication step should keep row 1260 as the canonical record - it carries the fuller name form - and fold this row into it.

HOSPITAL_PROFILE LEFT BLANK ON PURPOSE, AND THE TRAILING-SLASH TRAP WAS CHECKED. The AIG URL for him is a PLURAL /doctors/ URL carrying a trailing slash, https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-naresh-kumar/ , and it is returned with the title '404 Page Not Found'. Per the AIG method, a plural URL with a trailing slash 404s universally, so that title is NOT by itself proof he has no page. I re-checked by running further aighospitals.com-restricted queries specifically to surface an unslashed or singular-family variant: none was returned - not /doctors/dr-naresh-kumar without the slash, not /doctor/dr-naresh-kumar, not /doctor-profile/dr-naresh-kumar, and no translate.goog mirror. Since no live URL appeared verbatim, none could be recorded, and typing the unslashed variant myself would be constructing a URL in breach of golden rule 2 - so hospital_profile stays empty and the dead slashed URL is logged in other_profiles as evidence only. NOTE THE PATTERN FOR THE REMAINING AIG ROWS: this is now the third AIG doctor in this dataset with a decayed plural /doctors/ URL (row 1215 Dr. Sridhar Dasu and row 1260 are the others), and https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-c-narasimhan/ also returned a 404 title in this session while the singular https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-c-narasimhan is live - strong evidence AIG has migrated from the plural family to the singular one, leaving stale plural URLs in the index. Prefer the singular /doctor/ family when searching.

BAND IS MEDIUM, matching row 1260 for consistency. drnareshkumar.co.in is primary self-published and per section 5 can never be the second source that earns High; aighospitals.com confirms the department but has no live page for him; Practo and Skedoc are corroborating-only.
